productionBindingProbe.scope: Production createEntrant, adapter step and actual dynamics front/rear brake forces; no private solver or brake argument interception.
productionBindingProbe.fixture: Fresh independent physical states at 45 m, speed 28 m/s, Raw assists, front input 0.1 and rear input 0.1, one 1/240 s production step. Disc temperature is the only changed state between variants.
productionBindingProbe.result: At unsaturated front/rear input 0.1, each hot GP axle produces 0.78 times its cold force independently. SBK1000 and all three dirt adapters produce identical front/rear forces and resulting speed across all six temperature variants.
productionBindingProbe.fixtureDesignNote: The low brake demands expose actuator gain below the real tyre friction cap. Larger demands can reach that cap and mask the gain in actual contact force; no tyre, ABS, landing or event threshold was changed.
productionBindingProbe.sourceReproductionNote: The retained probe source contains its original absolute repository path. Reproducing elsewhere requires changing only that path and running against the recorded source bytes.

actualOffroadCallPath.finding: MX250, MX450 and SM450 definitions select DirtBikeVehicle.
Race entrants are constructed through createEntrant.
Festival also selects DirtBikeVehicle for offroad bike definitions.
Overrides the entire step, calls dynamics.step directly with its own front/rear brake inputs, and never calls super.step; flight and recovery remain in the dirt adapter.
The new fading branch is inside the overridden road step and additionally permits only definition IDs gpr1 and gpr2.

historicalFullRaceGate.interpretation: The fourteen fingerprints remain the exact bytes used in the completed historical full gate. The old record's sourceHashesMatchCurrentFiles field describes its capture time. It is not a claim that all fourteen are still current after R4: BikeVehicle changed, and this evidence establishes that the changed step is bypassed by the actual dirt adapter while focused production controls pass.

retention: Native reports, console output and the exact executed probe script are embedded as UTF-8 strings. Re-encoding each rawUtf8 value reconstructs the original byte count and SHA-256 without the scratch directory.
limitations: This verifies the fade binding and vehicle eligibility. The assigned initial disc temperatures are controlled fixtures, not a natural heat-up/cool-down cycle or measured real brake temperatures.
The focused run contains twenty assertions across three files; the 36 physical probe states are a separate controlled integration witness, not 36 additional Vitest tests.
No complete offroad race gate or GPU/browser test was rerun for this isolated physics delta.
This record does not validate the concurrently integrated paint, glow, crowd or caliper appearance; rendered verification is recorded separately.
No all-seed, real-device performance or measured real-world brake-temperature claim.
